thread:
Vik: quick follow-up from the postmortem — checkpoint-state leak showed up again in Jan/Mar/Apr windows. want owners, tickets, and a tidy handoff so this doesn't live in limbo.
Hannah: i'll own the investigation (R). creating RWD-31415 now. will post repro steps & minimal trace by Thu.
Jorge: i'll take remediation (A)  focusing on tracker GC + sticky handles. opening RWD-31416 for the patch + canary.
Nina: i'll be consulted on alerting + runbook edits (C). will propose a new alert for checkpoint retention growth.
Vik: proposed RACI: Hannah=R, Jorge=A, Nina=C, Vik=I (pm). ok?
Hannah: quick triage note: leak occurs when checkpointed tensors survive a retry loop during transient storage errors; memory delta spikes after 6 retries. sample log: ```
2026-04-11T02:13:07Z checkpoint-service warn: retry=6 tensor_ref_count=12 leak_candidate=true
2026-04-11T02:13:08Z gc info: freed=2MB total_alloc=1734MB
```
Hannah: next steps in RWD-31415: (1) add weak refs + leak detector hooks (2) reproduce in perf sandbox with retry storm (3) collect allocator snapshots. Jorge can pick up hooks once triage doc is ready.
Jorge: mitigation plan RWD-31416: (1) short-term: cap retries at 3 + add explicit release path, (2) long-term: integrate weak-ref pool + periodic compaction, (3) canary on 5% fleet for 72h.
Nina: alerting RWD-31417: create warning when checkpoint_retention_growth > 20% over 15m and page when > 40% over 10m. will add a runbook with rollback steps.
Vik: gating: do not rollout cluster-wide until canary retention growth <= baseline for 48h and no new OOM alerts. add gating to RWD-31416/RWD-31417.
Hannah: added gating note to RWD-31415 and linked the mitigation ticket. tagging ops-bot to create a standing 30m sync until closure. @ops-bot please schedule weekly.
ops-bot: Created Jira tickets RWD-31415 (investigation), RWD-31416 (remediation), RWD-31417 (alerting). Created recurring event "Checkpoint leak remediation" starting 2026-04-14 09:00 PT, repeating weekly. Invitations sent to Hannah, Jorge, Nina, Vik.
Jorge: draft PR for retry cap posted in RWD-31416; requesting review from Hannah and Nina. small code paths + unit tests.
Hannah: reviewing now. small comment on the weak-ref naming but LGTM after that.
Nina: will update dashboards and add the runbook once PR merges. also adding a short customer-facing note in the postmortem doc so oncall sees the recurrence history.
Vik: timeline: triage -> PR -> canary (72h) -> staged rollout within 10 business days. target close date: 2026-04-25.
Hannah: i'll hand off final traces and the leak detector to Jorge after repro is validated. Jorge owns rollout and monitoring during canary.
Jorge: will monitor canary and merge after perf tests pass. will escalate if retention growth doesn't stabilize.
Nina: gating added to RWD-31417. will watch alerts and page on threshold. :eyes:
Vik: thanks all, leaving thread open for blockers.
